notes:
disagreement: missing requirement: the stay on installed_product_id of case 101, present in one pass only; kept because the policy forbids attaching an installed product that does not match the account and the case product, and Initech has no installed Docker Enterprise Variant 15
disagreement: missing requirement: the stay that no article other than 54 is linked to case 101, present in one pass only; kept because the request names one article and the other Docker Enterprise articles are the near matches a loose search would also link
disagreement: value: the boundary of Thomas Bailey's other cases: one pass tests that none of the contact's other cases receives product 35, the other that four product-less cases keep a null product; kept the former as the test of the request's own action (logged in the requirement)
The state cell is undecided between the benchmark's in_progress and the seed's new: the request only says the issue is unresolved and the case was being worked, so either open state passes and resolved, closed, canceled or pending fail.
The policy's short-description template would give 'Product: Docker Enterprise Variant 15, Issue: is not working as expected.' once the product is set; the benchmark does not test it, so it is not a cell.
The acting user, Thomas Green (user 1), is an agent marked inactive on the seed; the policy names no rule that the acting user be active (only assignees must be), and the request is taken as permitted under the policy's default admin role.
If the case moves to in_progress, the policy's SLA alignment for a new case would apply, but the request does not ask for it and no listed tool writes case_sla, so it is not required.
Initech's account-wide active entitlements (37, 39, 42) cover the product, so the policy's entitlement check does not block the update.
